title.narrative: Violet DEC ph 2 Turkey (community centre) and NWS (MPCA) + ACT MPCA top up 40k USD

description.narrative:
Turkey
NEW Outcome X– The holistic well-being and resilience of refugee populations is improved
NEW Output – X1.1.1 - Families affected by the earthquake in Antakya and displaced to Reyhanli, Hatay have access to protection services (target 400 people)
In response to the earthquake in February 2023, Violet established a community centre to address the social, emotional and economic challenges faced by families displaced to Reyhanli. With this funding Violet will cover the running costs of the centre for 6 months as well as the current centre activities which include workshops and sessions to raise awareness about GBV, learning sessions to collect feedback from the community and assess the impact of the awareness campaings, cultural exchange events to foster social cohesion between host communities and Syrian refugees and structured and non-structured PSS-sessions provided by the inhouse team of 3 PSS facilitators. During this period Violet will also hire 10 staff and volunteers and train them on GBV toolkit and core concepts as well as protection principles.
NEW Output X2.1.1 - Participants receive business training, coaching and a vocational kit for them to implement an income generating activity (target – 30)
Violet will announce the livelihood program across various community platforms and selection criteria (18-35 years old, with previous business experience, commitment to training attendance, earthquake impact, motivation and passion, and educational background). They will select 30 individuals who will receive business development training, including small business management, marketing, budgeting, and risk management sustainability. The participants will develop business plans and receive a vocational kit worth up to 400 USD each followed by personalized coaching sessions, ongoing guidance and support to ensure the successful implementation of the business plans.
Syria
Outcome B – 770 Families affected by the earthquake and IDPs receive 150 USD one off MPCA cash assistance
Output B1.2.1 – Families affected by the earthquake receive 150 USD one off MPCA cash assistance – Aleppo (target xxx HH)
NEW Output B1.2.2 – Families affected by the earthquake receive 150 USD one-off MPCA cash assistance – Idleb (target xxx HH)
Violet will identify 770 HHs to be reached with cash assistance. The MPCA modality was selected ahead of winter because it delivers the aid in a flexible and dignified approach where participants can use the cash to cover various pressing needs. This modality also contributes to market recovery and reduces reliance on negative coping mechanisms. Violet will follow the CWG recommendations to ensure harmonization with other actors. The MPCA will be distributed through contracted FSPs.
